name: Jenschke Orchards
description: Jenschke Orchards is a orchard in Fredericksburg, TX. Visitors come for Blackberries, Peaches, Plums, Tomatoes, and Pecans, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
